items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: You know, same way Lord Price in so many senses gave me that offer.

ctx.x: You mentioned Little Richard. What was Little Richard like?

Oh, man, you know, nicest man in the world. I mean, see, Little Richard and I were fairly good friends. He asked me to go on the road with him. He said, I don't want you to quit your band, you can go on the road with me. I said, man, I'm going to quit my band and go on the road with you. You know, same way Lord Price in so many senses gave me that offer. And you know, I always have been just a bit independent. I like to be on my own. I don't never really like to ask.
